square.description: Simple axis-aligned 10x10 square. Baseline inside/outside/on-edge/on-vertex coverage.

concave_notch.description: 10x10 square with a downward-pointing triangular notch cut into the top edge (notch vertices (6,10),(5,6),(4,10), apex at y=6). At y=8 the notch spans x in [4.5, 5.5] (linear interpolation between the notch's slanted edges), so (5,8) sits inside the excluded notch while (2,8) -- well clear of the notch -- stays inside the polygon body. Proves ray-casting respects true polygon shape instead of falling back to a convex hull.
